models.name: Buffett Indicator
models.source_name: Fed Z.1 nonfinancial corporate equities (NCBEILQ027S) / BEA GDP via FRED

models.name: S&P 500 CAPE Ratio
models.source_name: History of Market (historyofmarket.com) CAPE, CC BY 4.0; methodology Robert Shiller

models.name: Price / Sales Ratio

models.name: Interest Rate Model
models.desc: Forward earnings yield minus Moody's Baa yield (pp).
models.direction_note: High spread = stocks cheap vs bonds (−)
models.source_name: History of Market forward P/E (CC BY 4.0); Moody's Baa via FRED (BAA)

models.name: Earnings Yield Gap
models.direction_note: High gap = stocks cheap vs Treasuries (−)
models.source_name: Shiller earnings yield; 10Y Treasury via FRED (GS10 / DGS10)

models.name: Sahm Rule
models.source_name: Sahm Rule (real-time) via FRED SAHMREALTIME; Claudia Sahm

models.name: State Coincidence
models.desc: Share of states with a 3-month decline in the coincident index.

models.name: Margin Debt
models.desc: NYSE/FINRA debit balances in customers' securities margin accounts.

models.name: Junk Bond Spreads
models.substitute_of: ICE BofA US High Yield OAS (FRED BAMLH0A0HYM2)
models.substitute_note: ICE BofA HY OAS is Copyrighted: Pre-Approval Required on FRED and is not redistributed. Using Moody's Baa − 10Y Treasury as a public credit-spread stand-in.
models.source_name: Moody's Baa minus 10Y Treasury (FRED BAA − GS10)

models.name: VIX Fear Index
models.source_name: Cboe VIX via FRED VIXCLS (Copyrighted: Citation Required)

models.name: Economic Policy Uncertainty
models.source_name: Baker, Bloom & Davis via FRED USEPUINDXM (public domain)

models.name: Consumer Confidence
models.direction_note: High confidence = complacency (+); low = contrarian bullish (−)
models.source_name: Surveys of Consumers, University of Michigan via FRED UMCSENT (Citation Required)

recession_probability.method: NY Fed yield-curve recession probability (probability of recession 12 months ahead)
recession_probability.source_name: Federal Reserve Bank of New York

notes: SD scores are z-scores vs each series' own history (typically since 1990), multiplied by a direction so +SD is bearish/expensive/risky for the composite, then capped at ±2.
Signal map: ≤−1.5 Strong Buy; ≤−0.5 Buy; ≤0.5 Hold; ≤1.5 Sell; else Strong Sell.
ICE BofA HY OAS is not redistributed (FRED Pre-Approval Required); Baa−10Y is the labeled substitute.
Price/Sales has no free redistributable source and is shown as unavailable.
